title: Event
description: One message on the system event stream. This is how NON-authoritative components (control-plane, fdk-research, agent-runtime) communicate. Crucially, an ALLOW/DENY/LIMIT/DEFER decision is NOT an event type here — only the kernel emits a Decision, via the decision.schema. Research emits 'suggestion'/'risk_score' events, never a decision.

type.description: Event kind. 'suggestion'/'risk_score'/'threat_assessment'/'simulation_result'/'alternative_policy' are the ONLY outputs research may emit (advisory). 'threat_assessment' is FDK's behavioral classification of an actor/action (benign|suspicious|malicious|unknown) — ADVISORY input to a possible CONTAIN decision, never itself a decision. 'decision_issued' references a Decision but is emitted only by the kernel.

action_ref.description: The action this event concerns, if any.

payload.description: Event-type-specific data. For 'risk_score': {score: number in [0,1]}. For 'decision_issued': the Decision object. Advisory payloads carry NO authority.
